name: Out of the Darkeness
author: nickogoodwin
description:
Our hero, the Circle ⚪, is being held captive by the dastardly Squares ◻️, and must escape. It's dark and every room looks pretty much the same. Luckily for the Circle, there seems to be keys and pressure plates just sorta haphazardly strewn about. With any luck (and just by walking around and picking stuff up), the Circle will be able to make it Out of the Darkness.

Keyboard + Mouse controls only.
